# homeassistant Provider

Manages a Home Assistant instance as code.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    homeassistant = {
      source = "toelke/homeassistant"
    }
  }
}

# url and token can also come from HOMEASSISTANT_URL and HOMEASSISTANT_TOKEN.
provider "homeassistant" {
  url   = "http://homeassistant.local:8123"
  token = var.ha_token # long-lived access token of an admin user
}

variable "ha_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `insecure` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification. Defaults to `false`; can also be set with `HOMEASSISTANT_INSECURE`.
- `timeout` (String) Per-request timeout as a Go duration, e.g. `"30s"`. Defaults to `"30s"`; can also be set with `HOMEASSISTANT_TIMEOUT`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Long-lived access token of an admin user. Required; can also be set with `HOMEASSISTANT_TOKEN`.
- `url` (String) Base URL of the Home Assistant instance, without `/api`, e.g. `http://homeassistant.local:8123`. Required; can also be set with `HOMEASSISTANT_URL`.
